Instructions (press H to toggle)

For each image, decide where the light comes from, judged from the main object's cast shadow, in image coordinates.

  • L: light comes from the left side of the image (the shadow falls toward the right).
  • R: light comes from the right side of the image (the shadow falls toward the left).
  • A: a shadow is visible but the direction is ambiguous or not left/right (straight toward or away from the camera, shadows that contradict each other, can't tell).
  • N: no visible cast shadow of the main object.

A diagonal shadow (e.g. falling to the back-right) counts as the side it leans toward: back-right means L. Keys: L / R / A / N to label and advance · ← / → to move · Backspace to go back. Progress autosaves in this browser. Click Export CSV when done and send the file.
